name: Dashboard for Woo
author: webangon

sections.description:
Dashboard for Woo helps WooCommerce stores replace the plain default My Account area with a polished, branded customer dashboard. Build layouts visually, control account menus, show useful order and customer summaries, and make account navigation feel faster with AJAX loading.

Useful links:

  • Product page
  • Buy Pro
  • Support

Key features:

  • Visual builder – create designs from WooCommerce > Account Dashboards > Add Design. Edit controls on the left while previewing the real My Account page on the right.
  • Responsive previews – check desktop, tablet and mobile sizes, then preview any WooCommerce account endpoint before publishing.
  • Flexible layouts – choose sidebar left, sidebar right, top tabs, icon rail, app shell, hero banner, tiles or centered layouts.
  • One-click templates – start from ready-made styles such as Classic, Midnight, Boutique, Minimal, Studio, Launchpad, Fresh and Corporate.
  • Design controls – adjust colours, spacing, width, radius, typography, shadows, active menu style, sticky navigation, profile card and page title.
  • Menu editor – reorder items, rename labels, hide links, choose icons and add custom links. New endpoints from other plugins can appear automatically.
  • Designed dashboard – add a greeting, intro text, summary cards, recent orders and quick links, or keep WooCommerce’s default dashboard copy.
  • Smart assignments – publish different designs for everyone, selected roles or individual users. More specific matches take priority.
  • AJAX navigation – load account endpoints, pagination and order links inside the dashboard without a full page reload where possible.

Notes

  • The My Account page must contain the [woocommerce_my_account] shortcode (or the equivalent block); designs replace the myaccount/my-account.php and myaccount/dashboard.php templates.
  • Theme overrides: copy templates/my-account.php or templates/dashboard.php to yourtheme/webangon-dashboard/.
  • Forms (edit account, addresses) still submit normally; WooCommerce processes and redirects as usual.
  • Hiding a menu item removes the link only – the endpoint URL still works.
  • Managing designs requires manage_woocommerce (filter webangonwd_manage_capability).

External Links

  • Product details and demo
  • Upgrade to Pro
  • Get support
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Added five layouts: Icon rail, App shell, Hero banner, Tiles and Centered (eight in total), with a visual layout picker.
  • Added eight one-click templates (Classic, Midnight, Boutique, Minimal, Studio, Launchpad, Fresh, Corporate) that set layout, colours and style.
  • Added a site-wide “Load My Account pages with AJAX” switch under WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → My account page.
  • Top tabs, Tiles and Hero menus wrap on desktop instead of hiding items off-screen.
  • Profile name and email follow the navigation text colour, so they stay readable on dark menus.
